g.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 13b: Are the predicted quantiles calibrated?'

text.font-family: Matter XH, DM Sans, sans-serif

g.text: Figure 13b: Are the predicted quantiles calibrated?

g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Six NGED solar farms, daylight hours, September 2019 to June 2026. ERA5: ECMWF's reanalysis of past weather. CAMS: satellite irradiance service. For each hour the XGBoost model predicts the value that the outcome should fall below 10%, 20%, and so on up to 90% of the time. Each line is one variable set. The dashed diagonal is a perfect match. Above the diagonal means outcomes fall below the predicted value more often than intended. Main XGBoost tuning setting only. A variable set is the list of inputs the XGBoost model is given. G0: sun position, ERA5 solar radiation (ssrd), and air temperature (t2m). Each group adds to the one before. G1: total cloud cover. G2: low, mid, and high cloud cover. G3: clear-sky radiation. G4: cloud water and cloud base height. G5: direct beam. G6: wind and thermal radiation. G7: humidity and haze. G8: snow and albedo. G9 (the full set): all other ERA5 variables. G10: G9 plus CAMS aerosol. Clearness index: irradiance divided by the irradiance at the top of the atmosphere. Exploratory: not named in the study plan before any result existed, and not corrected for multiple comparisons.'

text.font-family: Matter XH, DM Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Six NGED solar farms, daylight hours, September 2019 to June 2026. ERA5: ECMWF's reanalysis of past weather. CAMS:
For each hour the XGBoost model predicts the value that the outcome should fall below
10%, 20%, and so on up to 90% of the time. Each line is one variable set. The dashed
diagonal is a perfect match. Above the diagonal means outcomes fall below the
predicted value more often than intended.
A variable set is the list of inputs the XGBoost model is given. G0: sun position, ERA5 solar
radiation (ssrd), and air temperature (t2m). Each group adds to the one before.
G1: total cloud cover. G2: low, mid, and high cloud cover. G3: clear-sky radiation.
G4: cloud water and cloud base height. G5: direct beam. G6: wind and thermal radiation.
G7: humidity and haze. G8: snow and albedo. G9 (the full set): all other ERA5 variables.
Clearness index: irradiance divided by the irradiance at the top of the atmosphere.
Exploratory: not named in the study plan before any result existed, and not corrected for multiple comparisons.
